description: A Homerun Manifest: a service's configuration, kept as .homerun.json (or .homerun.yaml / .homerun.yml) in its repository and applied on every deploy, or applied to any service with `homerun manifest apply`. Every key is optional and uses the REST API's field name; keys left out keep their current value, and envVars are merged into the service's environment rather than replacing it.

$schema.description: The JSON schema this file follows, for editor support

authAllowedEmails.description: Addresses let through the login wall, exact or *@example.com for a whole domain. With an emailed sign-in method, leaving this and authAllowedUserIds empty lets any Homerun account through.

authAllowedGroups.description: Group or role claims from the OAuth provider's id token, or Homerun roles (admin, developer, viewer, custom, app-user), let through the login wall.

authAllowedUserIds.description: Homerun account ids let through the login wall, service accounts included (a service account only gets through when listed here).

authPaths.description: Path patterns authPathsMode applies to. A pattern matches whole path segments anywhere in the path, a leading / anchors it at the root, * matches anything and ? one character, case-insensitively.

authPathsMode.description: Which paths the login wall covers: all, only the authPaths, or all except them. Applied on the next deploy, which saving queues for a running service.

authProviders.description: Sign-in methods the login wall accepts. One or more of "password", "email-otp" (emailed code), "magic-link" (emailed link) and "oauth:<provider name>"; an emailed method must be switched on under Authentication, with SMTP configured.

authRequired.description: Put the service behind Homerun's login wall.

autoRollback.description: Roll back to the previous revision when a new one turns unhealthy.

blockedPaths.description: Path patterns Traefik answers with a 403 instead of passing to the app, same syntax as authPaths. Applied on the next deploy, which saving queues for a running service.

category.description: The service's category in the services list.

command.description: Argv list, null keeps the image's own

containerPort.description: The port the app listens on inside the container, where Traefik sends its traffic.

cpuLimit.description: CPU limit in cores, e.g. "0.5"; null for none.

cronSchedule.description: 5-field cron expression the service is redeployed on.

defaultDomainEnabled.description: Also route the service at <slug>.<base domain>.

dnsResolvable.description: Publish the service's hostnames through the instance's DNS automation.

domainPorts.description: Container port per domain, when it isn't containerPort.

domains.description: Hostnames routed to the service. One may carry a path ("example.com/api") to route only that path and what's under it, even while another service has the bare hostname.

entrypoint.description: Argv list, null keeps the image's own

envVars.description: Environment variables, merged into the service's environment: a variable set elsewhere and missing here is kept. Keep secrets out of the repository; set them on the dashboard.

gitBakeFile.description: The Docker Bake file for the bake method, relative to the build context.

gitBuildContext.description: The build context directory, relative to the repository root. The manifest is looked for there first, then at the root.

gitBuildMethod.description: How the repository is built: a Dockerfile, a Docker Bake target, Nixpacks, Railpack, or Heroku or Paketo buildpacks.

gitBuildTarget.description: The Bake target, or the Dockerfile stage to build.

gitDockerfilePath.description: The Dockerfile, relative to the build context.

gitIgnorePaths.description: Repo path globs whose changes never deploy on push, same syntax as gitWatchPaths: a push deploys when a changed file matches the watch paths and none of these.

gitWatchPaths.description: Repo path globs (apps/api/**, *.md) a push has to change a file under to deploy the service or one of its environments. Empty lets every file through. A pattern without a slash matches at any depth, a folder path everything under it. Only applies when the push payload lists its files (not on Bitbucket, not when polling).

healthcheckCommand.description: A shell command run inside the container to check it's healthy; null for the image's own.

healthcheckDisabled.description: Turn the health check off, the image's own included.

healthcheckRetries.description: Failed checks in a row before the container counts as unhealthy.

healthcheckStartPeriodSeconds.description: Seconds after start during which failures don't count.

httpCacheTtl.description: Cache the service's responses at the edge for this many seconds; null to turn caching off.

image.description: The image to run, for a service that isn't built from its repository.

imageScanEnabled.description: Scan the image for vulnerabilities on deploy.

memoryLimitMb.description: Memory limit in MiB; null for none.

portProtocol.description: Whether containerPort speaks TCP, UDP or both.

previewAuthAllowedUserIds.description: authAllowedUserIds for pull request previews, e.g. a CI service account.

previewAuthProviders.description: Sign-in methods the previews' login wall accepts. One or more of "password", "email-otp" (emailed code), "magic-link" (emailed link) and "oauth:<provider name>"; an emailed method must be switched on under Authentication, with SMTP configured.

previewAuthRequired.description: Put every pull request preview behind the login wall.

previewBranchExclude.description: Glob patterns whose matching branches never get a preview, even when included.

previewBranchInclude.description: Glob patterns (* any run, ? one character) a pull request's head branch must match one of to get a preview. Empty lets every branch through.

previewCopyVolumes.description: Whether each new preview gets its own copy of this service's volumes.

previewDefaultDomain.description: Route previews at their default hostname.

previewDomainTemplate.description: Hostname template for previews, e.g. pr-{pr}.example.com.

previewEnvOverrides.description: Environment variables set on every preview over what it inherited; {pr}, {branch} and {slug} are filled in.

previewInheritEnv.description: Whether pull request previews start from this service's environment variables.

previewUptimeEnabled.description: Probe each pull request preview's uptime. Applied when a preview is created or redeployed.

previewsEnabled.description: Deploy a preview for every pull request.

primaryDomain.description: The hostname shown and linked as the service's address.

pullPolicy.description: When to pull image: always, only when missing, or never.

replicas.description: How many replicas to run under swarm; 0 stops it.

restartPolicy.description: Docker's restart policy for the container.

runAsUser.description: Docker User (uid, uid:gid, name or name:group), null keeps the image's

scaleToZeroMinutes.description: Minutes without a request before the service is stopped until the next one; null never sleeps it.

stripPathDomains.description: The domains with a path whose prefix is stripped before the request reaches the container.

tracesEnabled.description: Collect OpenTelemetry traces from the service.

uptimeEnabled.description: Probe the service's address for the uptime history.

title: Homerun Manifest
